scope: Month-by-month 2015 audit of Greater Albuquerque Bicycling Advisory Committee / Greater Albuquerque Active Transportation Committee (GABAC/GAATC) and Greater Albuquerque Recreational Trails Committee (GARTC) minutes and substantive attachments.

source_checks.local_document_review: research/staging/document-review is empty in this checkout. The preserved backups/ directory was not modified; its August 2026 ZIP contains no document-review files.
source_checks.onbase: Queried the City of Albuquerque Public Access Boards and Commissions collection using the exact GAATC and GARTC committee names and the MINUTES record type.
source_checks.onbase_2015_gabac_agenda_recovery: On September 8, 2026, reran City OnBase custom query 136 with committee keyword 412 set to GREATER ALBUQUERQUE ACTIVE TRANSPORTATION COMMITTEE and record-type keyword 413 set to AGENDAS. It returned official 2015 GABAC agenda documents 12053705–12053714 except July; the corresponding MINUTES result set returned only January document 12053715 and December document 12053718. January was excluded from the agenda fallback because approved minutes exist; July had no agenda and is recorded as cancelled in the June agenda.
source_checks.current_city_and_former_city_urls: Reviewed the GAATC OnBase guidance page, the GARTC maintained agendas-and-minutes page, and the paginated former City GART Minutes & Agendas document collection.
source_checks.former_gart_collection_exhaustive_crawl: On September 7, 2026, recursively retrieved the former City collection root and all nine pagination offsets (b_start:int=0 through 160), with 14 retrieved HTML pages, 165 unique document links, and no pagination remaining. Four legacy RTF download endpoints returned errors; their item pages and the collection pagination were retrieved. Crawl record: project-state/discovery/gartc-former-city-collection-crawl-2026-09-07.json.
source_checks.internet_archive: Direct Internet Archive CDX retry: the known GARTC City document-collection prefix returned no captures; a City municipal-development GABAC filename search returned 2015 agendas and the already-known January minutes but no missing-minute original; and the historic GAATC collection query received the Archive's temporary-offline response. The outage and empty indexes are not evidence of absence.
